evidence.claim: Analyst requested review of transaction 3660263 on card C01727-K2 to identify commonalities among several cards showing losses this month without a shared device.

Recipient email domain sc.rr.com was paid by 16 other cards (including C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, C02167-K2, C03060-K1, C04146-K1, C04668-K1) in the 30 days prior to case opening, linking them in a coordinated pattern.

Card C01727-K2 has three online product C transactions (3660261 for $305.41, 3660262 for $366.35, and 3660263 for $295.92) totaling $967.68 delivered to recipient domain sc.rr.com with missing device identity telemetry.
Card C01727-K2 has 5 prior closed confirmed fraud cases (CC-0723, CC-1501, CC-1833, CC-1975, CC-4908), including recent CNP fraud case CC-4908 opened on 2016-10-16.
Closed cases on neighboring cards paying sc.rr.com include confirmed fraud cases CC-2888, CC-5117 (card_not_present_fraud), and CC-3907 (undocumented).

Flagged transaction 3660263 ($295.92) sits within the cardholder's historical spend baseline prior to opening (prior median amount $107.86, prior maximum amount $1,419.28 over 121 prior transactions).
Billing region 231.0 on transaction 3660263 is the card's modal region, representing 119 prior transactions across 90 active days.

case.summary: Card C01727-K2 is assessed as fraud (probability 0.92) under an undocumented coordinated recipient-email fraud pattern across 17 cards paying sc.rr.com with no shared device. The episode comprises online transactions 3660261, 3660262, and 3660263 with total exposure of $967.68. The verdict is driven by cross-card recipient email sharing and the card's history of prior confirmed fraud (CC-4908). Recommended actions include blocking card C01727-K2 (L1 route) and filing a SAR (L2 route).

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed to document an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case AC-HHF-006. The activity involves customer C01727 using Visa debit card C01727-K2, which is connected to 16 other cards through a shared recipient email domain with no shared device profile. On 2017-01-17 at 15:29, online transaction 3660261 for $305.41 with product code C was conducted in billing region 231.0 and delivered to recipient email domain sc.rr.com. On 2017-01-18 at 19:40, online transaction 3660262 for $366.35 with product code C was conducted in billing region 231.0 and delivered to sc.rr.com. On 2017-01-28 at 07:59, online transaction 3660263 for $295.92 with product code C was conducted in billing region 231.0 and delivered to sc.rr.com. These transactions lack device identity telemetry and form a coordinated recipient-email mule ring across 17 cards paying sc.rr.com. Prior to transaction 3660263, the card's baseline as of opening consisted of 121 prior transactions with a median amount of $107.86 and a maximum amount of $1,419.28. A prior suspicious activity report was filed on this card under closed case CC-1975, CC-1833, CC-1501. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Under case opened 2017-01-28, case creation, monitoring of connected cards, and analyst escalation were completed, while a block of card C01727-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious amount of $967.68.
